Hi Julian — thanks, great questions. Short answers up front:

- Data residency: We can commit, contractually, to host all customer production inference workloads and persistent customer artifacts (models, embeddings, KV cache) exclusively in EU regions (Frankfurt or Dublin) for the account you designate. We will include a clause that prevents cross-region egress except under customer-approved failover scenarios you explicitly authorize.

- Private connectivity: We support VPC peering and a managed private connector (similar to PrivateLink). Typical setup includes a peering attachment or private endpoint, BGP or static routing, and optional restricted egress via customer-managed NAT.

I'm attaching a short diagram and a draft commitment letter for your security team to review. For the technical runbook and firewall rule template I want to loop in our infra team — copying Kimberly and Rishi.

Sean / Kim — technical notes for the runbook. See inline: 

- KV cache / replication: All persistent KV state for NovaMed will be pinned to the EU cluster. We do not replicate persistent KV cache outside of the account's designated region. Ephemeral inference caches used for single-request performance are destroyed and never exported; we log lifecycle events.

- Failover and cross-region fallback: We can implement a policy-driven failover that will only trigger cross-region fallback when both: (a) the designated EU region becomes unhealthy and (b) NovaMed has pre-approved a failover plan. Failover events are audited and require a signed toggle via your ops channel.

- Private peering limitations: VPC peering supports direct routing for control plane and private egress. For some clouds we recommend a PrivateLink-style endpoint for reduced blast radius and IAM-scoped endpoints. Peering requires a short window of firewall rule changes on the NovaMed side (ingress from Redwood peering CIDR).

- Firewall rule template: allow TCP 443 from Redwood peering CIDR; allow BGP (if using dynamic routing) on TCP 179 from Redwood router IP; restrict management ports to your jump-hosts.

I'll attach the onboarding runbook xlsx and a small checklist. Kimberly — please verify the public IPs and ASN we'll present.
